files.content:
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@8f4b7f84864484a7bf31766abe9204da3cbe65b3 # v3.5.0
      - name: Secret scan
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@44c470ffc35caa8b1eb3e8012ca53c2f9bea4eb5 # v2.3.2
      - name: Build
        run: python -m compileall src
      - name: Test
        run: python -m pytest tests

name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@8f4b7f84864484a7bf31766abe9204da3cbe65b3 # v3.5.0
      - name: Publish
        run: python -m build

# payments-api

Session and payment endpoints for the Acme storefront.

## Installation

```bash
python -m venv .venv
pip install -e .
```

## Usage

```bash
python -m src.api.handler
```

pull_request.title: Add an LRU cache in front of the session store (#412)
pull_request.body:
Repeat session lookups hit the database on every request.

This adds a small LRU in front of the session store.

Closes #412.

commits.message: feat(cache): add an LRU in front of the session store
fix(cache): expire cold entries after ten minutes
